ss-delta 0.5.1 fixes the original game's Spirits' offerings: the beast arms' thrust no longer crashes the game, and Spirits' Flame Arrow and Stone Arrow fire their arrows again. The release now carries its compiler, so the first build downloads only the PS Vita firmware and asks nothing of Microsoft; the setup can also build without internet, from files you downloaded before. The cursor hides when the mouse is still.

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `ss-delta-v0.5.1-windows.zip` | `ss-delta.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `ss-delta-v0.5.1-linux.tar.gz` | `ss-delta.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `ss-delta-v0.5.1-macos.tar.gz` | `Soul Sacrifice Delta.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `ss-delta-v0.5.1-android.apk` | **ss-delta** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. The first time, its importer asks for your own dump of Soul Sacrifice Delta (US PCSA00152 or EU PCSF00532, update 1.30), downloads the PS Vita firmware from Sony (about 180 MB; the compiler is in the download), and builds the game on your computer in a few minutes. From then on the program goes straight to the game. Nothing of the game is in these downloads. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md).

macOS: the app isn't signed by a registered Apple developer, so macOS refuses it the first time. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway".

## Fixed

* **Spirits' Wolf fang and Spirits' Dragon fang: the thrust no longer crashes the game** ([#18](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/18)), or misses. Their punch still pointed at a skill Delta removed; it now does the arm's damage, as Delta's own fang arms do.
* **Spirits' Flame Arrow and Spirits' Stone Arrow fire their arrows** ([#19](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/19)). They were cast with no arrows, so nothing showed and nothing was hit. Part of the Spirits' effect data had been left out; with it, the other Spirits' offerings (the swords, giant arms, eggs, roots, Frostfluff and Falconfeather) also have all their effects, as in the original game.

The Spirits' offerings are rebuilt once, by themselves, the first time 0.5.1 starts.

## New

* **The compiler comes with the release; no Microsoft licence.** The game's code is now compiled with zig on Windows too, as on Linux and macOS, and each release carries it: the first build downloads only the PS Vita firmware (Windows downloaded about 650 MB before), and there is no Microsoft licence to accept. The downloads are about 90 MB larger.
* **Building without internet.** `--download-only <folder>` saves everything the setup downloads; a build then takes the files from that folder (`--offline <folder>`, the importer's "Downloaded files" row, or a folder named `offline` in the game's folder). Firmware files you already have work too, whatever their names. See [Without internet](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#without-internet).
* **Fallback downloads.** When Sony's server doesn't answer, the setup takes the same files from the Wayback Machine's copies, checked by SHA-256.
* **The cursor hides by itself** ([#16](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/16)) when the mouse has been still for 3 seconds, and at once when you use a key or a gamepad; moving the mouse shows it again. Hide idle cursor on the settings menu's Mouse page turns it off.
* **RecompLauncher**: when it runs the setup again with the same release and the same dump, the setup now ends at once ("Already built") instead of building the game a second time. `--rebuild` builds anyway.

## Upgrading from 0.5.0

No new build is needed: the game's recompiled code is the same as in 0.5.0. Unpack 0.5.1 over your game's folder (replace the files) and start it; saves and settings are kept. RecompLauncher builds the game again after the update by itself, as for every release. Coming from 0.4.x, build again with `--install` (see the [0.5.0 notes](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/releases/tag/v0.5.0)); from 0.3 or older, see [Updating](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#updating).

Every release's changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

SHA-256 and build attestations: see the files attached, and `gh attestation verify`.
